body.purpose: 14px/400 with tabular numerals; table and form text.

label.purpose: 13px/700 on chips, counts and small buttons.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: Table container, login card, menus, toasts. Darker black variant in dark theme.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Modal dialogs only, over a 50% navy backdrop.

shadows.name: urgent-halo
shadows.purpose: Ring around active status chips on urgent rows.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: Rail mark settle (0.7s, 14ms stagger over 30 rows) and toast pop (0.25s).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables rail settle, toast pop, button transition

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar becomes top bar and bottom tab bar.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Table becomes card rows; dialogs dock as bottom sheets.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 14px/1.45 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b9c3cf); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #17202b); transition: background-color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #f7f8fa); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #1f5fa8); border-color: var(--accent, #1f5fa8); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #194e8a); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #194e8a); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #1f5fa8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary actions: surface fill, strong hairline.
components.css: .ds-btn2 { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 14px/1.45 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b9c3cf); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #17202b); transition: background-color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn2:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #f7f8fa); border-color: var(--muted, #566475); } .ds-btn2:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #1f5fa8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chips
components.description: Solid colour, icon and word together; needs-date is dashed outline.
components.html: 5d late Due today In 3d Needs date
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 26px; padding: 0 10px 0 8px; border-radius: 6px; font: 700 13px 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-overdue { background: var(--overdue, #b45309); color: #fff; } .ds-today { background: var(--today, #f2b01e); color: var(--today-ink, #1b1300); } .ds-upcoming { background: var(--upcoming, #1e7b4f); color: #fff; } .ds-needs { background: transparent; color: var(--needs, #5b6777); border: 1.5px dashed var(--needs, #5b6777); }

components.name: Urgent Tag
components.description: The only red element; flag icon plus the word Urgent.
components.html: Urgent
components.css: .ds-urgent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--urgent, #c62828); color: var(--urgent-ink, #fff); font: 700 11px 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill filter with a status-coloured count badge; selected inverts to ink.
components.css: .ds-fchip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 6px 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b9c3cf); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #17202b); font: 600 14px 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-fchip:hover { border-color: var(--muted, #566475); } .ds-fchip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--ink, #17202b); color: var(--bg, #f3f5f8); border-color: var(--ink, #17202b); } .ds-n { min-width: 26px; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 999px; text-align: center; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; background: var(--overdue, #b45309); color: #fff; } .ds-fchip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #1f5fa8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Due Rail
components.description: Signature: a shared date axis with today in the middle and one mark per order; late marks are doubled.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: block; width: 168px; height: 30px; overflow: visible; } .ds-rail .a { stroke: var(--line-strong, #b9c3cf); stroke-width: 1; } .ds-rail .t { stroke: var(--muted, #566475); stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 2 3; } .ds-rail .m { stroke: var(--overdue, #b45309); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: 36px field, strong hairline, global accent focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 240px; min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 10px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #17202b); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b9c3cf); border-radius: 8px; font: 400 14px 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #1f5fa8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Left rail item with trailing count; current page gets a 14% accent tint.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 188px; } .ds-nav button { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; background: none; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--muted, #566475); font: 600 14px 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav button span { margin-left: auto; } .ds-nav button:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #f7f8fa); color: var(--ink, #17202b); } .ds-nav button[aria-current='page'] { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #1f5fa8) 14%, transparent); color: var(--accent, #1f5fa8); }

narrative.overview:
A laboratory plate in corporate dress. The ground is quiet and neutral (cool paper in light, graphite in dark), actions share one steel-blue accent, rules are hairlines, and a single grotesque with tabular numerals carries all text. Everything loud is reserved for delivery status, so a glance at the screen answers "what is late" before any word is read.

The one signature idea is the due rail: each order carries a thin vertical mark on a ruled date axis with today in the middle, so lateness reads as distance from the centre line, not as a label to decode. Layout and controls stay standard web components (a sidebar, a table, buttons, native dialogs); the rail and the status system are where the identity lives.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral ground, one blue accent, five assigned status hues, each with its own shape and word.
Hairline borders and a single soft shadow; depth is mostly tonal.
One typeface (Hanken Grotesk), 14px base, tabular figures everywhere.
Light and dark themes share one semantic token set; only values change.
Dense but not tight: 36px controls, 8px radius, 10-14px cell padding.

rules.name: The Red Means Urgent Rule
rules.body: Red appears only for the urgent flag. Overdue is orange, errors are ink-bordered, destructive actions are bold with an ink border. If it is red, a person marked it urgent.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Every status is colour plus shape plus word: chip = fill + icon + label; rail = mark geometry (double line, thick line, dashed line, dot, cross) + an aria-label; urgent = red + flag icon + "Urgent" text. Needs-date and cancelled differ from the others by outline and strike-through, not hue.

rules.name: The Spend Colour On Status Rule
rules.body: Chrome stays neutral and blue. A new saturated hue on a non-status element is a defect.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Hanken Grotesk only; rank with weight and the sizes above. No second family.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use the shared --shadow token for lifted surfaces; only modal dialogs get the deeper one. No hard offset shadows.

dos: Do keep the screen neutral and let status carry all saturated colour.
Do pair every status with an icon or shape and a word; give each rail mark its own geometry.
Do use the semantic tokens (--surface, --ink, --line-strong, status triplets); every new component must work in both themes.
Do use the 36px control height, 8px radius, 600 weight, and the global 2px accent focus ring.
Do keep tabular numerals on, and keep one primary button per view.
Do collapse tables to card rows at 860px with the same content and actions.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion for any new animation (rail settle, toast pop and button transitions already do).
donts: Don't use red for anything but urgent (errors, destructive actions, overdue, cancel).
Don't signal status with colour alone, or with a pastel pill that has no icon or word.
Don't add a second typeface, or use size jumps where weight would do.
Don't introduce a new accent or decorative saturated hue.
Don't use hard offset shadows or heavy ambient shadows outside dialogs.
Don't hide data on mobile; rearrange it.
